profile_text.body:
Dynatrace, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, traded under the ticker DT, with SEC CIK 0001773383. On its own site the company describes itself as an observability platform built for the age of AI, combining observability, AI, automation, and application security in a single platform. It says the platform is meant to help customers innovate faster, operate more efficiently, and drive better business outcomes, and it calls itself the AI-powered observability leader.

The site's framing of AI centers on autonomous operations. It quotes Stephen Elliot, Group Vice President at IDC, saying the future of observability is preventive and autonomous, using deterministic AI and AI agents to coordinate actions across cloud platforms, developer tools, and IT service management. A customer testimonial on the site says Dynatrace's AI engine provides insights for early detection of potential system issues without false alarms, reducing the time required to identify root causes from hours to minutes.

The company's legal exposure is recorded as concentrated in Massachusetts, with 126 matters there. No individual lawsuits, products, or MCP servers are listed alongside the profile.
